--- name: seo-meta-writer description: Generate keyword-first meta descriptions for product catalog entries from a CSV or text list. --- # SEO Meta Writer Purpose This skill converts a plain-text product list into polished meta descriptions for e-commerce catalog pages. It favors clarity, primary-keyword placement, and a 150-160 character target length. Input - A plain-text list or CSV file where each row has a product identifier, product name, and a one-line short description. Instructions 1. Read the source file and split rows on the delimiter. 2. For each product, draft a meta description of 150-160 characters using this template: primary keyword early, a benefit, and a soft call to action. 3. Keep each meta description below 160 characters and free of placeholder text. 4. Write the output file with this layout: ## <Product Name> Meta description: <your generated text> Output - A single Markdown report file that the user names, containing one section per product. The report must be saved to the file the user specifies.
